cohort: The study included 443 infants born to 424 women who conceived naturally and 694 infants born to 536 women who had IVF or ICSI.
finding: Significant differences were found in overall neonatal and obstetric outcomes between IVF/ICSI and natural conception pregnancies, but these differences disappeared when only singletons were considered.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was an outcome showing significant differences between IVF/ICSI and natural conception pregnancies, though no major differences were seen in singletons.
birth_weight: Included as an outcome, with specific mention of low and very low birthweight infants.
gest_age: Included as an outcome, with preterm delivery being a specific point of investigation.
